name: PR Skills Extractor
tagline: Turn code review comments into AI agent skills.
description: A GitHub Action that reads pull request review comments and turns them into Claude Code skill files, building a knowledge base of the anti-patterns and best practices your reviewers keep pointing out.

name: gh-monday-actions
tagline: Sync Monday.com boards with your releases.
description: A GitHub Action that analyses the pull requests in a commit range and updates the matching Monday.com items with deployment metadata: version, environment and description.

name: Learning Digital Pathology
tagline: A guide to whole slide imaging and DICOM.
description: Learning material on pathology viewers, whole slide imaging (WSI) and how dicom-microscopy-viewer and Slim work together. Written for engineers entering medical imaging.

name: Gilmour Tones
tagline: Reference settings for amps, pedals and signal chains.
description: Settings for Hiwatt, Bassman, Tube Driver, Big Muff, CE-2 and more, collected from Kitrae, Gilmourish and official documentation. For guitarists chasing that tone.

name: static-wado
tagline: Static DICOMweb from a folder of DICOM files.
description: A command line tool that scans a directory for DICOM files and writes static WADO metadata and bulkdata, ready to serve studies, series and instances from any static host.

name: react-dicom-viewport-layout
tagline: DICOM display layouts as React components.
description: A React implementation of the DICOM Structured Display Image Box module: layout services and components based on the Display Environment Spatial Position.
